notes.title: Update 0.2.6 is here with first bugfixes!
notes.notes:
[h2]First Demo update! [/h2]


[h3]We hope you are having fun with the game so far! We are working on the development all the time and has just released our first update during the Steam Next Fest.
 [/h3]


[h3]In the 0.2.6 version we've:
[list]
[*] Moved fragments of keys on 2 altars to reduce the chance of a softlock (blocking oneself from proceeding in the game by playing in a different, not predicted by the creators, way)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to get stuck on the puzzle in front of the village
[*] Done some other minor fixes
[/list][/h3]


[b][h3]If you have any feedback, or just want to share your experience with the game, join our community on Discord 💖 We would love to see you there![/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41841678/6261c9b26ed61a7005e0ab72f573b31631944b0a.png[/img]
